s: Dine hakanat maakal libhema beshabbat ubo y"b seipim: en koberin et hatteben bakkebara sheyyippol hammotz laaretz, velo yannichennu bemaqom gaboah kede sheyyered hammotz, shehare zeh keborer. Abal notelo bakkebara venoteno letok haebus, veap al pi shehammotz nopel lipamim meelayv derek niqbe hakkebara, kevan sheeno mekavven lekak velo "pesiq resheh" hu — muttar:
Lo yimdod adam seorim latet lipne behemto, ella meshaer beomed dato, mippene shehammedida asura mishshum obadin dechol ap shello bimqom miqqach umimkar, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"v:

Kebar nitbaer besiman shk"a shehammursan hu middebarim sheenan bene gibbul, veim gebalo beshabbat — yesh omerim shehu patur min hattora, abal asur middibre soperim ligbol mursan libhema o lattarnegolim kedarko bechol, ella al yede shinnuy kegon legoblo meat meat, kemo shennitbaer sham, o apillu harbeh bebat achat ella shello yemares beyado achar shennatan hammayim letoko kedarko bechol, ella maabir bo tarvad o maqqel sheti veereb apillu kamma peamim ad sheyyitareb yapeh, shekkevan sheeno memares beyado, velo yesabbeb hattarvad o hammaqqel besabib kedarko bechol ella maabiro sheti veereb — hare zeh shinnuy gamur. Umuttar gam ken lenaaro mikkeli el keli ad sheyyitareb yapeh. Umuttar leareb hammursan bederek zo bikli echad apillu kor vaapillu korayim, kepi mah shetztzarik libhemotayv hayyom, umechalleq oto bekelim harbeh venoten lipne kol behema ubehema. Uledibre haomerim shehamgabbel hammursan chayyab min hattora, vaapillu bintinat mayim bilbad belo gibbul chayyab, ki netinat hammayim zehu gibbulo, kemo shennitbaer sham — asur litten mayim lemursan beshabbat apillu al yede shinnuy, ella im natan bo hammayim meereb shabbat — azay en begibbulo beshabbat issur min hattora ella middibre soperim, vehittiruhu al yede shinnuy bederek zo shennitbaer. Ukebar nitbaer sham sheyyesh lehachamir kasbara zo, veken nohagin:

Qashshim shel shibbolim sheagedu bishnayim ushelosha meqomot — muttar lehattiran beshabbat kede shettokal mehem habbehema im eno qesher shel qayyama. Abal asur leshapshep bahem beyadayim kederek sheosim beokle behema kede sheyyehu nochim leoklam, mippene shekkol dabar shehu okel, dehaynu shehu rauy laakila belo tiqqun — asur litroach bo lehakshiro uletaqqeno yoter letaanug beolma. Abal dabar sheeno okel, dehaynu sheeno rauy laakila belo ezeh tiqqun sheen bo serak melaka — muttar letaqqeno velaasoto okel, kegon etzim sheqqetzatzan min hailan mibbeod yom veyesh maakilin otam libhema beodam lachim umeshapshepim bahem beyadayim lehaakilam, sheenam reuyim belo shipshup — muttar leshapshepam beshabbat. Veken dilluim shehem qashim — muttar lechattekam lipne habbehema sheenah yekola leoklam belo chatika. Vehu shennitleshu mibbeod yom, abal im nitleshu beshabbat, apillu al yede nokri shettelashan leatzmo — asurim betiltul, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shk"h:

Mechattekin nebela lipne hakkelabim, apillu nitnabbela hayyom. Veen bah mishshum muqtzeh, apillu lo hayeta chola kelal mibbeod yom, shello haya dato aleha kelal lakkelabim mibbeod yom, mippene sheen muqtzeh bedabar shehissiach adam dato mimmennu ella im ken dechao beyadayim, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"y. Bammeh debarim amurim? Binbela haqqasha, shei epshar lahem leoklah belo chatika, vaapillu neekelet lahem al yede haddechaq belo chatika — muttar litroach lechattekah lahem yoter, kemo shennitbaer lemala (veayyen siman shk"a im muttar lachtok basar chay daq daq lipne haopot). Veken en chotekim shachat vecharubim lipne behema ben gassa ben daqqa, mippene shehem reuyim lahem belo chatika. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh:

En obesin et haggamal, dehaynu shemmaakilo beyado harbeh kol kak ad shemmarchibim bene meayv keebus, shezzehu toreach shello letzorek hayyom. Velo doresim, dehaynu sheddores lo maakal bigrono lemaqom sheen haggamal yakol lehachaziro, shezzehu gam ken toreach yoter. Abal malitim oto, dehaynu litchob hammaakal lemaqom shehu yakol lehachaziro kesheyyirtzeh. Veken haagalim — en meammerin otam, dehaynu litchob lemaqom sheenan yekolim lehachaziro, abal malitin lemaqom sheyyekolim lehachaziro, ap al pi shekkavvanato kede lepatteman. Veken haddin beavvazin vetarnegolim, shemmuttar litchob hammaakal bepihem lemaqom sheyyekolim lehachaziro. Veken beyonim baytiyyot:

Veken shear opot o chayyot haggedelot babbayit — hittiru litroach litten lahem mezonot umayim, mippene shemmezonatan aleka. Abal en notenin mayim velo mezonot laddeborim velo leyone shobak veyone aliyya, vaapillu lehashlik lipnehem asur, mippene sheen mezonatan aleka, sheyyotzeim veokelim bassadeh. Abal notenin mezonot lipne keleb, shemmezonotayv aleka. Vaapillu keleb shel hepqer sheeno megaddelo bebeto — mikkol maqom qetzat mitzva yesh litten lo meat mezonot, shehare haqqadosh baruk hu chas alayv al shemmezonotayv muatim umashheh akilato bemeayv shelosha yamim. Abal en notenin mezonot lipne chazir, mippene sheen mezonotayv aleka, shehare ameru "arur haish miyyisrael shemmegaddel chazirim":
Yesh nohagim latet chittim lipne haopot beshabbat shira, veeno nakon, shehare en mezonotehem aleka:
Muttar lehaakil tolaat hammeshi, lepi shemmezonotayv aleka, sheen lo mah sheyyokal ki im mah sheyyaakilo haadam:

Ap al pi sheadam metzuvveh al shebitat behemto, muttar lehannichah shettokal mehamchubbar beshabbat, shenneemar: "lemaan yanuach shoreka vego'", vezo hi neyacha shellah. Umuttar apillu lehaamidah beyadayv al gabbe asabim mechubbarim, veen chosheshim shemma yitlosh mehem beyadayv lehaakilah, lepi shehu issur chamur beene habberiyyot. Abal lo yaamidenna al gabbe dabar haasur betiltul middibre soperim, mippene sheissuro qal beene habberiyyot, vechosheshim shemma yittol mimmennu beyadayv lehaakilah. Velo aseru ella lehaamidah al gabbah mammash, abal muttar laamod bepaneha beinyan shello tukal lehattot ella derek sham vetokal meatzmah, shekkevan sheeno omed samuk laasabim — en lachush:

Notelin maakal millipne chamor venotenin lipne shor, mippene sherauy hu lo, shehachamor eno metil ririn veen mah shellepanayv nimas, verauy hu (lechatteko) letitt[o] lipne hashshor. Abal en notelin millipne shor litten lipne chamor, mippene shennimas berire hashshor veeno rauy od lachamor ella al yede haddechaq, veqarob levadday shello yoklennu, venimtza toreach bechinnam beshabbat. Veyesh machamirim gam ken bishar mine behema, shello yittol millipne achat velitten lipne acheret sheenah minah. Veen limchot beyad hannohagin hetter:

Shor shemmepattemin oto, vegorepim haebus shellepanayv latet letoko hatteben vehasseorim shello yitareb bahem aprurit veyaqutz bemaakalo — asur legorpo beshabbat, apillu hu ebus shel keli, gezera mishshum ebus shebbaqqarqa. Veshebbaqqarqa yesh lachush shemma kesheyyigrepo veyireh bo gumot — yashveh otan haggumot bemitkavven kede shello yippelu hasseorim letokan. Veasur gam ken lesalleq hatteben millepanayv keshehu rab, kede shello yidresennu biri, mippene sheyyesh bo teben shennimas bemidras raglayv veeno rauy lo od, vehu asur betiltul:
